offering_description.value: The company designs and manufactures pumps and packaged pumping systems for water and wastewater utilities, industrial operators, contractors and equipment manufacturers. It also makes fuel transfer equipment and fire protection pumps and sells through distributors, sales representatives and direct OEM relationships.

primary_products.value: centrifugal pumps and packaged pump stations; fuel transfer pumps and meters; fire protection pumps and systems; vertical turbine pumps; positive displacement pumps

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pump distributors, equipment manufacturers, industrial operators, construction and fire protection contractors, fuel handlers and farms; B2G: Municipal water and wastewater utilities and public works agencies

end_markets.value: water and wastewater; industrial processing; construction and dewatering; fuel handling; fire protection

revenue_model.value: product sales: Pumps, packaged pump systems, fuel transfer equipment and replacement parts; service fees: Pump repair and rebuilding

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds pumps and packaged systems from metal castings and components for distributors, utilities and contractors; component supplier: Supplies pumps for integration into other manufacturers’ equipment; service provider: Repairs and rebuilds pumps for equipment owners
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Water and wastewater pumps, industrial pumps, fuel transfer equipment and fire protection systems

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent pump and fluid-handling equipment distributors and dealers; direct sales: Equipment manufacturers and selected end users; agents / brokers: Independent sales representatives serving pump and fire protection markets
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Manufacturing is subject to workplace safety and environmental rules, and fire pump systems must meet applicable fire codes.

notes: The scope of repair and rebuilding services across subsidiaries is uncertain.
